svg.desc: Five stages left to right: catalogue, retrieval to about 300 candidates, feature fetch, LightGBM ranker, business rules to a top 10. Below, a stacked bar splits a 100 ms p99 budget: retrieval 20, features 20, ranking 30, rules 5 and 25 ms outside the stages.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A ranking cascade and its latency budget

svg.text: Cheap stages shrink the set so the expensive stage only sees a few hundred items.
